audit_metadata.institution: Department of AI & Data Science, RMK Engineering College
audit_metadata.milestone: Phase 5 Step 0.1 — Comprehensive Risk Investigation, Root Cause Analysis, and Solution Architecture

issues_investigated.root_cause: Phase 4 used isolated subprocess bridges for ML and RAG tools; the Base Python 3.11 environment lacks orchestration dependencies (langgraph, langchain-core, langchain).
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: Base Python 3.11.9 hosts pydantic 2.13.4, mcp 2.3.0, sqlalchemy 2.0.52, alembic 1.19.1, fastapi 0.141.1, tensorflow 2.21.0. langgraph and langchain-core are NOT installed.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy A: Install into Base Python 3.11
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Optimal. Pure Python libraries; zero C++ conflicts; unified in-process dispatch (<1ms); preserves clean 2-tier architecture.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy B: Dedicated .venv-orchestration
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Rejected. Creates a 3-venv architecture; introduces 15-30s Windows subprocess cold-start latency per agent turn.

issues_investigated.root_cause: Two-phase commit window: create_ticket_with_approval_gate commits at line 67 in ticket_service.py; handle_create_maintenance_ticket commits token consumption at line 931 in tools.py.
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: ticket_service.py db.commit() followed by tools.py db.commit(). Failure between commits leaves active ticket while token JTI is not recorded in consumed_tokens.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy A: Caller-Controlled Single Atomic Transaction
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Optimal. Pass commit=False to ticket_service; execute ticket insert, proposal update, and token insert inside single with db.begin() block.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy B: Nested Savepoints (begin_nested)
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Rejected. Does not resolve the fundamental two-commit separation.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy C: Idempotency Coordinator Table
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Rejected. Massive over-engineering for local SQLite architecture.

selected_solution.mechanism: ticket_service.py flushes without committing; tools.py wraps entire operation in atomic with db.begin() block.

issues_investigated.root_cause: DevelopmentHumanApprovalAdapter uses in-memory dictionary with static plaintext PINs. Lacks enterprise SSO and WebAuthn hardware binding.
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: backend/app/mcp_server/approval.py APPROVED_ENGINEERS dictionary containing mock credentials.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy A: Dev Adapter with Strict Environment Gate
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Selected for Phase 5 development. Fails closed if MANUMIND_ENV=production.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy B: Enterprise OAuth2/OIDC SSO
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Selected for Production Roadmap. Keycloak / Azure AD PKCE integration.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy C: WebAuthn / FIDO2 Hardware Tokens
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Selected for Production Roadmap. Phishing-proof hardware token challenge.

selected_solution.strategy: Pluggable Approval Gate with Environment Fail-Closed Guard
selected_solution.dev_mode: DevelopmentHumanApprovalAdapter with mock registry for local CI/CD
selected_solution.production_gate: Throws ApprovalConfigurationError if MANUMIND_ENV=production without EnterpriseSSOProvider
selected_solution.cryptographic_binding: HMAC-SHA256 (HS256) bound to proposal ID and canonical payload SHA-256 hash

issues_investigated.topic: LLM Provider Availability and Offline Operation
issues_investigated.root_cause: Multi-agent graph requires LLM reasoning; exclusive reliance on cloud API risks rate limits, air-gapped test failures, and nondeterministic outputs.
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: Sandbox has no outbound network access ([Errno 11001] getaddrinfo failed). External LLM calls will fail without local/mock fallback.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy A: Cloud API Only
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Rejected as sole strategy. Fails completely in offline/sandboxed academic test environments.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy B: Deterministic Mock LLM
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Selected for Automated Testing. Schema-conformant pre-calibrated diagnostic responses.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy C: Multi-Provider Client Interface (ManuMindLLMClient)
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Selected as Primary Architecture. Configurable provider (Gemini / OpenAI / Mock) with retry and non-hallucinating fallback.

selected_solution.strategy: Strategy C (ManuMindLLMClient with Deterministic Mock Fallback)
selected_solution.non_hallucination_guarantee: If all LLM calls fail, system never fabricates root causes; outputs workflow_status=FAILED, confidence=0.0, and presents raw evidence to engineer.

issues_investigated.root_cause: System produces 5 incommensurable numerical scores (IF density score, LSTM MSE error, ResNet softmax, RAG cosine distance, Agent confidence). Mathematical averaging is invalid.
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: IF score in [-0.5, 0.5]; LSTM error in [0, inf); ResNet in [0, 1]; RAG in [0.60, 1.0].

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy A: Weighted Arithmetic Average
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Rejected. Mathematically invalid; conflates anomaly divergence with failure probability.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy B: Deterministic Tiered Evidence Rubric
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Selected. Clear categorical evaluation (High >=0.80, Moderate 0.60-0.79, Low <0.60). Human review enforced for Low confidence.

selected_solution.strategy: Tiered Evidence Rubric with 0.60 Human Escalation Threshold

threshold_definitions.rag_cutoff: 0.60 minimum cosine similarity for manual relevance
threshold_definitions.human_escalation_cutoff: 0.60 synthesized confidence below which requires_human_review=True is enforced

issues_investigated.topic: RAG Prompt Injection and Citation Safety
issues_investigated.root_cause: Retrieved manual chunks injected into RCA Agent prompt could contain adversarial override instructions; XML tags alone can be escaped.
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: Corpus contains 564 canonical chunks and 123 synthetic placeholders. Malicious text could hijack LLM system directives.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy A: XML Tags Alone
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Rejected. Vulnerable to XML breakout payloads.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy B: Multi-Layered Context Defense Pipeline
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Selected. XML tag stripping, structural quarantine, instruction invariance directives, deterministic citation validation, synthetic labeling.

defenses: Tag sanitization and escaping before prompt insertion
Post-generation [CIT-X] citation validation against retrieved chunk IDs
Mandatory [SYNTHETIC DOCUMENTATION] labeling for 123 placeholder chunks

issues_investigated.topic: MCP Tool Permissions and Agent Isolation
issues_investigated.root_cause: All 9 MCP tools are registered on one server instance. Relying solely on prompt instructions to prevent unauthorized tool calls is vulnerable to jailbreaks.
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: server.py registers all tools. An agent given full server client could call propose_maintenance_ticket or create_maintenance_ticket without permission.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy A: Prompt-Based Tool Instructions
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Rejected. Unreliable; susceptible to model confusion and prompt injection.

candidate_strategies.name: Strategy B: Role-Based MCP Client Adapters
candidate_strategies.evaluation: Selected. Python-level wrapper classes exposing only permitted tool methods per agent role.

selected_solution.anti_self_authorization: Tool 9 is physically excluded from all agent adapters; callable only by Human Approval Node with valid HMAC token.

issues_investigated.topic: System-Wide Failure Handling and Workflow Recovery
issues_investigated.root_cause: Multi-agent workflows cross multiple process boundaries (stdio MCP, TF bridge, RAG bridge, SQLite DB, LLM APIs); lack of unified recovery causes unhandled crashes.
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: Subprocess bridges have explicit 60s and 120s timeouts; failure recovery must be standardized across all graph nodes.

core_invariants: MCP failure aborts workflow cleanly; zero tickets created
RAG bridge failure falls back to telemetry + maintenance history with confidence <= 0.45
Defect bridge timeout skips visual analysis and flags warning
LLM outage triggers deterministic rule-based fallback without hallucinating causes
Token replay or expiry rejects immediately; zero database mutations

issues_investigated.root_cause: Complex multi-agent graph requires rigorous verification across state validation, routing, prompt injection, atomicity, and performance benchmarking.
issues_investigated.empirical_evidence: Phase 4 verified 154 tests; Phase 5 introduces asynchronous graph transitions requiring dedicated test fixtures.

key_suites: Unified Transaction Atomicity Suite (Simulated rollback, concurrent replay)

remediation_summary.next_immediate_action: Phase 5 Step 1: Install pinned orchestration dependencies in Base Python 3.11
